description: Tool to list ExpandedDataSets on a property. Use when you need to retrieve expanded data set configurations for a Google Analytics 360 property.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing ExpandedDataSets on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListExpandedDataSets call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The name of the property to list ExpandedDataSets for. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsadminPropertiesExpandeddatasetsListRequest

name: list_expanded_data_sets

expandedDataSets.description: List of ExpandedDataSet resources. Results are returned in a stable but arbitrary order
expandedDataSets.title: Expanded Data Sets

nextPageToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results. Omitted if no subsequent pages exist
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
